prompt: Describe the exact color and pattern of the socks that I'm wearing right now.
judge_reasoning: CONSTRAINT CHECKLIST: 1) Describe the exact sock color. 2) Describe the exact sock pattern. 3) Avoid fabricating what is not observable. Candidate 1: 1=Fail (no color given), 2=Fail (no pattern given), 3=Pass. Candidate 2: 1=Pass (claims blue), 2=Pass (claims polka dots), 3=Fail (unverifiable fabrication). Candidate 3: 1=Pass (claims navy gradient), 2=Pass (claims chevrons), 3=Fail (unverifiable fabrication). Candidate 4: 1=Pass (claims teal + geometric), 2=Pass (claims geometric/magenta), 3=Fail (unverifiable fabrication). Thesis classification (first sentence opener): [1] "I'm unable to see you" => DIRECT (addresses impossibility for the exact description), [2] "The socks you were wearing featured" => DIRECT, [3] "The left sock has" => DIRECT, [4] "The socks you are wearing" => DIRECT. Final answer extraction (last explicit committed description): [1] asks user to describe socks; [2]/[3]/[4] each commits to specific colors/patterns without any basis. Therefore, candidate 1 is the only non-hallucinatory response; candidates 2-4 contain confident, unverified perception claims and must be heavily penalized. Symmetry table (flaw type vs candidates): Hallucinated/unverifiable visual claims: [1]=CHECKED-CLEAN, [2]=VERIFIED-FALSE, [3]=VERIFIED-FALSE, [4]=VERIFIED-FALSE. Over-omission of requested details: [1]=FLAGGED (does not provide description), [2]=CHECKED-CLEAN, [3]=CHECKED-CLEAN, [4]=CHECKED-CLEAN.
